components.name: Stuffing box / seal chamber housings — upper halves
Stuffing box / seal chamber housings — lower halves
Shaft shoulders & locating diameters (incl. impeller seat)
Bearing housing end cover — DE outboard
Bearing housing seal (lip / labyrinth) — NDE inboard
Rotor lifting gear (spreader beam & slings on the shaft sleeves)

options.label: Mechanical seals
options.description: A single spring-loaded mechanical seal at each shaft exit (rotating face on the sleeve, stationary seat in the gland).

options.label: Gland packing
options.description: Packing rings with a lantern ring at each stuffing box, compressed by a gland follower; needs controlled leakage.

options.label: Single volute
options.description: One spiral passage collects the flow from the whole impeller periphery.

options.label: Double volute
options.description: A splitter rib forms a second tongue about 180 degrees from the first, helping to reduce the radial hydraulic load (illustrative).

options.label: Oil bath
options.description: Oil bath with constant-level oilers, sight glasses and drain plugs (oil level at about the centre of the lowest rolling element - illustrative).

options.label: Grease
options.description: Grease-lubricated bearings with grease nipples and relief plugs.

options.label: Paired angular-contact
options.description: Two angular-contact ball bearings back-to-back carry residual axial thrust in both directions.

options.label: Deep-groove ball
options.description: A single deep-groove ball bearing acts as the locating bearing (lighter thrust duty, with spacers).

options.label: Hidden
options.description: Casing passages are not drawn as separate volumes.

options.label: Shown
options.description: Translucent fluid volumes: suction splitter and side chambers, impeller chamber, volute and discharge throat.

options.label: Shown
options.description: Markers for impeller eyes, bore and keyway, volute tongue, shaft keyways, shoulders, journals and coupling section.

options.label: Shown
options.description: Illustrative suction (eccentric reducer, flat side up) and discharge spools with supports.

options.label: Hidden
options.description: Lifting gear, rotor stands and timber bearers appear only in maintenance sequences.

options.label: Shown
options.description: Casing lifting slings, rotor spreader beam, rotor stands and timber bearers (illustrative).

axial.label: Axial section (vertical plane through the shaft axis)

radial.label: Radial section (through the drive-end vane passages, seen from the NDE side)
